notes: Each check has a name, a command and required; its optional settings (cwd, paths, diffCommand, cleanup, runIn, and the top-level containers map) are described under "Per-check settings" in docs/stop-gate.md of the myspec plugin. With cwd, $MYSPEC_SESSION_FILES is relative to that directory, but git diff --name-only prints repo-root-relative paths wherever it runs: a cwd check's diffCommand adds --relative, or cds to the root first.

checks.name: Lint
checks.description: Linter — replace with your project's lint command (e.g., 'npm run lint', 'pnpm lint', 'ruff check .')

checks.name: TypeCheck
checks.description: Type checking — replace with your project's type-check command (e.g., 'npx tsc --noEmit', 'pnpm typecheck')

checks.name: Test
checks.description: Test suite — replace with your project's test command (e.g., 'npm test', 'pnpm test', 'pytest')
